title: The new EBA guidelines on outsourcing will hit smaller EMIs harder than anyone admits…
author: Anna Kovač
snippet: 3 days ago … The new EBA guidelines on outsourcing will hit smaller EMIs harder than anyone admits. Compliance teams of two people cannot run a full vendor register, and yet …
reason: A compliance leader inviting discussion on exactly the pain point your clients have.

comments.text: We see the same pattern with our EMI clients — the register itself isn't the burden, the annual re-assessment cycle is. A lightweight criticality tiering usually cuts the workload by half without weakening the audit trail.
Do you expect national regulators to apply proportionality here in practice, or will the guidelines be enforced uniformly regardless of team size?
When we helped a two-person compliance team through this last year, the surprise wasn't the volume of vendors — it was how many 'non-critical' tools turned out to touch client data.

title: Slovenija je dobila novo digitalno banko — ampak ali jo sploh potrebujemo?
author: Marko Breznik
snippet: 2 days ago … Slovenija je dobila novo digitalno banko. Ampak ali jo sploh potrebujemo? Poglejmo številke: 87 % Slovencev že uporablja mobilno banko …
reason: Local, high-engagement debate squarely in your market — good visibility opportunity.

comments.text: Odlična analiza. Ampak številka, ki manjka: koliko od teh 87 % uporablja mobilno banko za kaj več kot vpogled v stanje? Prava priložnost za izzivalce ni v aplikaciji, ampak v produktih, ki jih tradicionalne banke ne ponujajo.
Kaj misliš, da je večja ovira za novo banko pri nas — regulatorni stroški ali navade uporabnikov?
